title: fleet.drain output
description: The typed drain outcome. `result` is `drained` when the host's nodes were really cordoned and their drainable pods evicted or reported, or `authority-move-plan` when the host holds the registry's authoritative state — then the authority stays, its node is only cordoned, and `plan` names the declared standby candidates. In both cases `workloads` says what happened to each running Odin pod first: rehomed with its state to a node its declared placement fits, or paused until the host is restored. Pods still present at the deadline are reported in `remained`, never an error.

node.description: The drained node, or the authoritative node when the host holds the authority.
